# ATS simulator upstream snapshot

- Repository: https://github.com/austinkennethtucker/cli
- Source directory: `atsim/`
- Commit: `cc37c5b1e3a4f7dfe17d9f043eb18021ff6faef4`
- Copied: 2026-09-15
- Package version: 0.1.0

The upstream package files are copied unchanged. `UPSTREAM-SHA256.json` records their SHA-256 hashes. No Git metadata, installed environments, or dependencies are included.

This is a source snapshot for review and future integration. Nav Center still uses its existing external `atsim` executable lookup; copying these files does not bundle or activate the scanner.

The upstream pyproject.toml declares MIT licensing. No standalone LICENSE file was present in the package or upstream repository root at this commit. Confirm and include the appropriate license notice before distribution.

The upstream README and Makefile retain machine-specific paths. Do not treat their install instructions as Nav Center installation steps.
